title: Mike Macdonald to Jalen Milroe: "Let's go take another step"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Macdonald to Jalen Milroe: "Let's go take another step"
sources.description: The Seahawks used a third-round pick in 2025 on quarterback Jalen Milroe — the same round in which they acquired Russell Wilson, 13 years earlier.
